SE.rules: A single seat, sofa, daybed, bed, hanging seat or outdoor seat at real size for adults to sit or lie on; seat height, depth and back angle realistic so a posed figure can sit on it; beds neatly made with plain bedding as stated; outdoor pieces in weather-proof materials.
SE.negatives: No cushions, pillows or throws beyond those stated, no recognisable designer chair, no gaming-chair branding, no children's chairs, bunk beds or cribs, no people-shaped dents, no bedding prints with text, no parasols, plants or ground, no plaques with text.

TB.rules: A table, desk or counter at real height (dining 75 cm, coffee 40 cm, counter 105 cm) with an empty top unless stated.
TB.negatives: No objects on the top unless stated, no chairs, no cables, no screens.

name.ja: 中国古典・世界の様式

CN.rules: Either Ming or Qing Chinese hardwood furniture with correct mortise-and-tenon construction and the stated period features, or a piece accurate to the stated culture or period style; always a generic example rather than a copy of a named designer piece, natural oiled, lacquered or upholstered finish as stated.
CN.negatives: No Japanese or Korean features on the Chinese pieces, no carved characters or seals, no religious images or objects, no royal or national insignia, no named designer reproductions, no metal screws or modern hardware on period pieces, no gilded excess unless stated, no mixing of styles.

PL.rules: A photographic posing aid or set piece at real size, plain and neutral, made for a model to sit, stand, step, lean or rest an arm on.
PL.negatives: No studio lights or stands, no backdrop, no text or brand marks stencilled on boxes, no props on it.
